intent_summary: Readiness diagnostics report supported, caution, or not_assessed based on the training pattern and calibration evidence.

criteria.criterion: Repeating seasonal structure with stable calibration can yield supported readiness.
criteria.notes: Assertions establish repeated seasonality, strong calibration improvement, and supported readiness.

criteria.criterion: Unstable declared seasonality or a drifting calibration center yields caution without making an otherwise completed run fail.
criteria.notes: Completed analyses retain caution reasons for weak seasonal repetition or calibration-center drift.

criteria.criterion: Insufficient calibration support yields not_assessed, including when the run otherwise completes.
criteria.notes: Both uncalibrated history and a completed run with three calibration samples return not_assessed.

criteria.criterion: Later evaluation changes do not rewrite the segment's training-and-calibration readiness assessment.
criteria.notes: Readiness reads training/calibration inputs once; tests compare identical segment and aggregate assessments after a later shift.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent re-inspected declared implementation references and criterion evidence in the current session after the outcome-title and deliverable-lane refactor.
Executed and inspected CLI examples, time preparation, policy replay, open-day monitoring, and MCP conversion evidence drilldown; .capabilities/reviews/deliverable-lanes/manual-checks.json.
